checks.command: python3 -c import json,jsonschema; s=json.load(open("schema/recommended_skills.schema.json")); e={"skill":"readme-docs","task_applicability":["readme"],"status":"withdrawn","distribution":"approved-public-metadata","withdrawal_reason":"revoked"}; d={"catalogue_version":"1.0.0","mapping_version":"1.0.0","entries":[e]}; errors=list(jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(s).iter_errors(d)); print("withdrawn record with no identity or qualification rejected:",bool(errors)); assert errors

required_fixes: Require a withdrawn recommendation to retain exact package identity and historical qualification; add a discriminating negative control.

issues.description: A schema-valid withdrawn entry can omit all package identity and qualification history.

limitations: Public metadata only; DS01 and external neutral handoffs remain unaccepted; no qualification or release.
